scope: Retain the first publication/return failure using the existing signed-original diagnostic writer, without another engine or journal version

red.test: R3c normal fixed SDK HTTP caller drives actual App journal and cold recovery after lost publication ACK

green.testNamePattern: publication first failure|R3c normal fixed|lost publication ACK|reference save lost|lock immediately after publication

invariants: First publication failure summary survives restart in the same signed-original row
Separate diagnostic-save acknowledgement failure remains main-only and cannot replace the first thrown cause
Original publication stays UNKNOWN, deliveryAttempted remains false, and a not-found read never authorizes another publication
No signed proof, network payload or diagnostic error is added to renderer summaries
limits: Controlled HTTPS, producer and QA keys; no public Auth admission or native GUI acceptance
Existing immutable build input was not hot-modified; any successor must be explicitly taken by original A
Whole-App build/install, real external business input and MONSTER remain unverified
